schema: Each idea: id, kind, pillar, name, pitch, closest, impact/confidence/effort (1–5), critical (demo critical path), status, reason. Score = I×C÷E (+2 critical).

ideas.name: Night album
ideas.pitch: Start a night from a crew; everyone who joins snaps into one shared roll.

ideas.name: Morning-after unlock
ideas.pitch: The roll develops at 10:00 local the morning after; nobody sees anything before.

ideas.name: Hold until morning review
ideas.pitch: Before the unlock, each author swipes their own shots: keep or toss.

ideas.name: Early reveal when everyone's up
ideas.pitch: Unlock early once every participant taps "I'm good", counted only after 7am.
ideas.reason: Sober check; makes the morning social.

ideas.name: 24-exposure roll
ideas.pitch: Each person gets 24 shots per night; counter shows what's left.

ideas.name: Develop animation
ideas.pitch: Tiles develop from amber blur to photo one by one with haptics at the reveal.

ideas.name: Locked-roll teaser
ideas.pitch: During the night show counts per friend ("Theo · 9 shots"), never the shots.

ideas.name: Auto-end at 5am
ideas.pitch: Live nights end at 05:00 local or after 12h; no capture after.

ideas.name: Who took it
ideas.pitch: Every photo credits its author; album sorts by time across everyone.

ideas.name: Save all
ideas.pitch: One tap saves every visible photo from the night to the camera roll.

ideas.name: Photo dump builder
ideas.pitch: Pick up to 10 from the album, reorder, share to Instagram.

ideas.name: Reactions
ideas.pitch: Tap-and-hold a photo for 5 big reaction emojis.
ideas.reason: Lightweight social glue after the reveal.

ideas.name: Highlights cover
ideas.pitch: Album cover auto-picks the most-reacted shot.

ideas.name: Night title + venue labels
ideas.pitch: Optional title and free-text venue ("The Nook"), never GPS.
ideas.reason: API + DB support titles/venues; the start-night UI skips them (speed first).

ideas.name: Video clips (5s)
ideas.pitch: Short clips in the roll, count as 2 exposures.
ideas.reason: Video pipeline is heavy; after the slice.

ideas.name: Dual-camera shot
ideas.pitch: Front + back together, BeReal-style.
ideas.reason: Fun, but slows capture in a dark bar.

ideas.name: Get-one-of nudge
ideas.pitch: Prompt: "No shots of Jules yet. Get one?"

ideas.name: 4-digit night code
ideas.pitch: Join a live night by a big 4-digit code said across the bar.

ideas.name: Night QR
ideas.pitch: Show a QR; friends scan with the camera to join.

ideas.name: Invite link
ideas.pitch: Share a link to the group chat; opens straight into the night or crew.

ideas.name: Crew invite link
ideas.pitch: Long-lived (7 day), revocable crew invite links.

ideas.name: Album-ready link for the group chat
ideas.pitch: After the unlock, one tap posts "Last night's album is ready: 63 photos from 5 people".

ideas.name: Auto-group from crew
ideas.pitch: Starting a night pings the crew; one tap to join the roll.

ideas.name: Guest join
ideas.pitch: Non-crew guests join a single night only; they never see crew history.

ideas.name: Suggest crew from guests
ideas.pitch: After a night, "Add Sam to Night Owls?" for guests who came twice.

ideas.name: Bluetooth proximity auto-join
ideas.pitch: Phones nearby auto-join the same night.
ideas.reason: Native BLE work + Color's creepiness lesson; code/QR covers it.

ideas.name: Contact book invites
ideas.pitch: Upload contacts to find friends.
ideas.reason: Privacy cost + Lapse's spam lesson; links instead.

ideas.name: Long-distance crews
ideas.pitch: Crew kind for old friends: weekly moment, recaps, nudges.

ideas.name: Weekly Nightcap moment
ideas.pitch: Fri 9–11pm local, one shot each, reveals when everyone's in or the window closes.

ideas.name: On this night
ideas.pitch: "1 year ago tonight" resurfacing from albums you were in.

ideas.name: Month in review
ideas.pitch: "October with Night Owls: 3 nights, 212 photos, 4 cities".

ideas.name: Gentle nudges
ideas.pitch: Privately nudge others about the quietest member; ≤1/week; never shaming.

ideas.name: Reunion countdown
ideas.pitch: Pin a trip date; countdown on the crew header.

ideas.name: Parallel nights
ideas.pitch: Two members out in different cities on the same night → side-by-side recap.

ideas.name: Home-screen widget
ideas.pitch: Latest album/moment on the home screen.
ideas.reason: Needs a dev build (widgets not in Expo Go).

ideas.name: Streaks
ideas.pitch: Daily/weekly posting streaks.

ideas.name: Read receipts
ideas.pitch: Show who viewed your photo.

ideas.name: City Nights
ideas.pitch: Opt-in curated nights at public venues; tables of 4–8.

ideas.name: Crew-to-crew tables
ideas.pitch: Sign up as a crew of 2–3; seated together.

ideas.name: Keep in touch (mutual)
ideas.pitch: After a City Night, opt in per tablemate; contact only on mutual yes.

ideas.name: Share my plan
ideas.pitch: Send venue + time to a friend outside the app.

ideas.name: Code of conduct gate
ideas.pitch: Accept 4 lines before the first City Night.

ideas.name: Table reveal 2h before
ideas.pitch: See tablemates' first names + one fun line 2 hours before.

ideas.name: People near you map
ideas.pitch: See who's out nearby.

ideas.name: DMs with strangers
ideas.pitch: Message tablemates before meeting.
ideas.reason: Harassment vector; mutual opt-in after instead.

ideas.name: Swipe on people
ideas.pitch: Swipe-match friend candidates.
ideas.reason: Feels like dating; group containers instead.

ideas.name: Gender-balance preference
ideas.pitch: Opt-in preference for tables with women/non-binary people.

ideas.name: Night mode
ideas.pitch: 21:00–06:00 or in a live night: bigger targets, fewer choices, longer undo.

ideas.name: Hold-to-confirm
ideas.pitch: Destructive actions need a 1-second hold with a filling ring.

ideas.name: Ask me in the morning
ideas.pitch: Irreversible actions at night are deferred to a 10am confirmation.

ideas.name: Big undo toasts
ideas.pitch: 8-second undo at night, 5 by day.

ideas.name: Breathalyzer gate
ideas.pitch: Prove sobriety with a reaction-time test before posting.
ideas.reason: Gimmicky and patronising; morning unlock solves it.

ideas.name: Ride home button
ideas.pitch: Big "get home" button opens Uber/Lyft at night end.

ideas.name: Haptic shutter
ideas.pitch: Heavy impact on capture, success haptic on save.

ideas.name: Hide-me
ideas.pitch: Anyone in a photo hides it from everyone but the author, one tap.

ideas.name: Opt-in tags
ideas.pitch: Tags start pending, visible only to the tagged person.

ideas.name: EXIF stripping
ideas.pitch: Server strips GPS/EXIF/XMP from every JPEG before storage.

ideas.name: Mutual-invisibility blocks
ideas.pitch: Blocked pairs never see each other's shots or share a night/table.

ideas.name: 21+ gate
ideas.pitch: DOB at sign-up; ID verification stubbed.

ideas.name: Report with auto-hide
ideas.pitch: Subject-category reports hide the shot pending review.

ideas.name: Signed media URLs
ideas.pitch: HMAC URLs bound to viewer + 10 min expiry.

ideas.name: Screenshot notice
ideas.pitch: Notify the author when someone screenshots.
ideas.reason: Unreliable on iOS; honest copy instead for now.

ideas.name: Face blur by default
ideas.pitch: Auto-blur faces of non-participants.

ideas.name: Public albums
ideas.pitch: Share an album publicly via link.

ideas.name: Dev mode + seeded demo
ideas.pitch: Seeded crews, nights, photos, 3 friends, time travel.

ideas.name: PGlite RLS harness
ideas.pitch: Run real migrations + RLS in-process for tests and mock mode.

ideas.name: Procedural demo photos
ideas.pitch: Generate bokeh/neon night photos deterministically.

ideas.name: Doctor/heal checks
ideas.pitch: Self-healing checks like GetOffTheCouch.

ideas.name: Push notifications
ideas.pitch: Expo push for night started / album ready.
ideas.reason: Needs EAS project + device; inbox in prototype.

ideas.name: Realtime shot counts
ideas.pitch: Supabase Realtime instead of 10s polling.

ideas.name: Validate with 5 friend groups
ideas.pitch: Run the prototype with real groups for 2 weekends.

ideas.name: Interview old-friend crews
ideas.pitch: 5 interviews with post-college groups.

ideas.name: Partiful import
ideas.pitch: Paste a Partiful link to pre-make the night with guests.

ideas.name: Venue partner nights
ideas.pitch: Bars host City Nights; drink specials.

ideas.name: Paid premium rolls
ideas.pitch: Pay for 36-exposure rolls / themes.

ideas.name: Live feed during the night
ideas.pitch: See friends' shots as they're taken.
ideas.reason: Breaks the reveal + the drunk safety net; that's NightOut's job.

ideas.name: AI best-of curation
ideas.pitch: Auto-pick the best 10 shots.
ideas.reason: Needs ML; reactions do it socially first.

ideas.name: Filters at capture
ideas.pitch: Choose filters before shooting.
ideas.reason: Slows capture; one consistent develop look instead.

ideas.name: Clean demo chrome
ideas.pitch: nightcap://devtools?chrome=0 hides the DEV tab for store-quality screenshots.

ideas.name: Dev build with real icon
ideas.pitch: expo run:ios dev client so the bundle id, icon and splash are ours, not Expo Go's.
ideas.reason: Heavy xcodebuild on a shared laptop; do it when quiet (ADR 0007).

ideas.name: Thumbnail variants
ideas.pitch: Serve 400px WebP thumbs for grids; originals only in the viewer.

ideas.name: Live Activity for a live night
ideas.pitch: Lock-screen Live Activity: shots left, who's in, one tap to the shutter.

ideas.name: Reveal sound
ideas.pitch: A soft shutter-roll sound as the album develops.
ideas.reason: Mornings + hangovers: no surprise audio (DRUNK_UX: haptics, not sound).
